citation.authors: Hahn RG, Ljunggren S, Larsen F, et al.
citation.title: A simple intravenous glucose tolerance test for assessment of insulin sensitivity

population.description: Twenty non-obese healthy volunteers, 8 females and 12 males, aged between 18 and 51 (mean 28) y, body weight 49-88 (mean 68) kg, BMI 23.4 (SD 2.3) kg/m2. None had a disease requiring medication; routine blood chemistry confirmed no metabolic disease. The Methods give the age span as a description of the people studied (same sentence form as the body-weight span), not as inclusion criteria, and no enrolment criteria are stated; it is entered as the observed extremes. Age SD not printed.

protocols.name: ivgtt_prebolus_fasted
protocols.description: Baseline plasma glucose on the IVGTT day (before the 300 mg/kg glucose bolus), after 12 h of fasting; arm ends before the bolus

protocols.name: clamp_120
protocols.description: Hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic clamp, 120 min (insulin 20 mU per m2 BSA per min, 20% dextrose adjusted to hold arterialized glucose at 5 mmol/L); plasma glucose and insulin entered at the printed means over 90-120 min of the clamp (Table 1: glucose 5.7 (SD 0.3) mmol/L, insulin 167 (SD 34) pmol/L), held for the whole 120 min since the paper prints no earlier clamp levels

findings.description: Baseline plasma glucose on the IVGTT day, after 12 h fast (Table 1 does not say which sample(s); entered as the arm's fasted state)

location.where: Table 1, IVGTT, column 'Mean (SD), or median(25th-75th percentiles)'

findings.description: Glucose uptake Mbw: glucose infusion rate per kg body weight, mean over the last 30 min (90-120 min) of the clamp

location.where: Table 1, Glucose clamp, column 'Mean (SD), or median(25th-75th percentiles)', unit μmol min-1 kg-1; Methods: infusion rate during the last 30 min

left_out.what: IVGTT volume of distribution and clearance of glucose (Table 1)
Plasma insulin at IVGTT baseline and clamp baseline, and MINMOD SI and SG (Table 1): medians with 25th-75th percentiles
Insulin AUC (AUCins) during the IVGTT, used in Tables 2-3 (no mean is printed)
Regression equations, r2 and prediction errors of IVGTT indices against Mbw (Tables 2-3, Figures 2-3)
Clamp-day baseline glucose and insulin (Table 1): fast length before the clamp is not stated (only that subjects reported at 7.30-8.00 AM)
IVGTT glucose and insulin time courses (Figure 1)
